# The Reset Co.

> Classical Ayurvedic Restorative Sanctuary in Bir Billing, Himachal Pradesh, India. Founded and administered on-site by certified BAMS Ayurvedic physicians Dr. Himanshu Bhatt and Dr. Aditya Kaundal.

## Core Retreat Information
- **Location:** Bir Billing, Kangra District, Himachal Pradesh, India (Elevation ~1,525m)
- **Programme Duration:** 4-Day Immersive Restorative Sanctuaries
- **Clinical Model:** Doctor-led, Vaidya-administered classical Dinacharya, condition-adaptive yoga, non-invasive Bahya Basti, and Shatkarma.
- **Accommodation:** Private stone-and-timber mountain sanctuary suites, pure sattvic organic nutrition, and structured digital detox.

## Retreat Programmes
- [The Awakening Pathway](https://www.thereset-co.in/programme-awakening.html): Foundation restorative retreat introducing classical Dinacharya, gentle Shatkarma, and tailored herbal support.
- [The Deep Rejuvenation](https://www.thereset-co.in/programme-rejuvenation.html): Deep cellular restoration featuring localized Bahya Basti, Rasayana formulations, and intensive physician consultations.
- [The Classical Reset](https://www.thereset-co.in/programme-reset.html): Complete bodily and mental recalibration with customized external therapies and individualized constitution optimization.
